adminEvents.detailsRoHint: The event as it appears on the public event page. Times are in New York time (ET).
adminEvents.cancelledNotice: Canceled on {date}. It is hidden from the public and member pages and takes no registrations.
adminEvents.cancelledPaid: {n, plural, one {# paid ticket needs} other {# paid tickets need}} a manual refund in Stripe.
adminEvents.kpiConfirmedD: {n, plural, =0 {No member tickets} one {# member ticket} other {# member tickets}}
adminEvents.kpiRevenueD: {n, plural, =0 {No paid tickets} one {# paid ticket} other {# paid tickets}}
adminEvents.bulkHint: Only confirmed registrations can be marked. Marking attended credits the event’s CPE hours to the person’s CPE log once; undoing it removes that credit.
adminEvents.cancelRegConfirm: Cancel the registration of {name}? They can register again while registration is open.
adminEvents.paidNoCancel: Paid ticket: refund in Stripe first
adminEvents.editHint: Changes appear on the public event page right away. Times are entered in New York time (ET).
adminEvents.slugHint: Used in the event link: /events/[address]. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
adminEvents.slugLockedHint: Locked because the event has registrations (their links and receipts use this address).
adminEvents.publishedLabel: Published (visible on the public events page)
adminEvents.cancelledNoPublish: Canceled events can’t be published. Restore the event first.
adminEvents.cancelBody: Canceling unpublishes the event and hides it from the public and member pages. Unpaid tickets are canceled. Everyone with a confirmed registration is emailed that the event is canceled, and their registrations are kept for the record; paid tickets are refunded manually in Stripe.
adminEvents.cancelConfirm: Cancel “{title}”? Everyone with a confirmed registration is emailed right away. You can restore the event later, but the email can’t be taken back.
adminEvents.restoreBody: Restoring brings the event back as a draft. Publish it again when it is ready. Registrants aren’t emailed when you restore an event, so let them know yourself.
adminEvents.deleteBody: This event has no registrations, so it can be deleted permanently.
adminEvents.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” permanently? This can’t be undone.
adminEvents.deleteBlocked: Events with registrations can’t be deleted (the registration history is kept). Cancel the event instead.
adminEvents.msg_invalid: The event wasn’t saved. Check the title, summary, start date and numbers, then try again. A start time inside the spring daylight-saving change (2:00–2:59 AM ET) doesn’t exist; pick another time.
adminEvents.msg_slugInvalid: The address can only use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens (up to 80 characters).
adminEvents.msg_slugTaken: Another event already uses this address. Choose a different one.
adminEvents.msg_slugLocked: The address can’t change because the event now has registrations. Nothing was saved.
adminEvents.msg_cancelledLocked: Canceled events can’t be published. Restore the event first.
adminEvents.msg_conflict: The event changed while you were editing. Nothing was saved; check it and try again.
adminEvents.msg_hasRegistrations: This event has registrations, so it can’t be deleted. Cancel it instead.
adminEvents.msg_cancelled: Event canceled. It is hidden from the public and member pages, and confirmed registrants are being emailed.
adminEvents.msg_restored: Event restored as a draft. Publish it when it is ready.
adminEvents.msg_noneSelected: Select at least one registration first.
adminEvents.msg_cancelledNoAttendance: Attendance can’t be marked for a canceled event.
adminEvents.msg_attendanceUnmarked: Attendance removed. The CPE credit was removed.
adminEvents.msg_attendancePartial: Attendance updated. Some selected registrations were skipped (not confirmed, or already in that state).
adminEvents.msg_attendanceNone: Nothing changed: the selected registrations are not confirmed or were already in that state.
adminEvents.msg_regNotCancellable: Only free or unpaid registrations can be canceled here. Nothing was changed.
adminEvents.proposedLabel: Proposed — date and details not confirmed
adminEvents.proposedFieldHint: Shows a Proposed badge and a tentative month instead of the date, hides prices, duration and CPE, and takes no registrations. Untick it once the event is confirmed.
adminEvents.cpeHint: Keep CPE in line with the duration (a CPE hour is usually 50 minutes of content).
adminEvents.fieldDate: Enter the start date and time.

adminEvents.msg_notStartedNoAttendance: Attendance can’t be marked before the event starts. Nothing was changed.

adminSettings.siteLead: Shown on the Contact page when set. Leave both empty to show nothing.
adminSettings.opsLead: Leave a policy on Default to keep the standard behavior.
adminSettings.dirDefault: Member directory checkbox on the Join form
adminSettings.ttlHint: Unpaid membership orders expire after this many hours. Empty = default ({value} h).
adminSettings.rejected: Rejected application that was paid online
adminSettings.paidTickets: Paid event tickets of deleted accounts
adminSettings.membershipRefund: Memberships paid online, of deleted accounts
adminSettings.msg_invalid: Some values are missing, too long or out of range. Nothing was saved.
adminSettings.msg_benefitsMismatch: Enter the same number of benefits in English and French. Nothing was saved.
adminSettings.msg_lastVisible: At least one tier must stay offered on Membership and Join. Nothing was saved.
adminSettings.msg_conflict: Someone else changed this setting in the meantime. Reload the page to see the current version, then try again.
adminSettings.msg_invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address. Nothing was saved.
adminSettings.resetTierConfirm: Discard the changes to “{name}” and restore the built-in texts and settings?
adminSettings.resetSiteConfirm: Remove the public contact email and postal address? The Contact page then shows neither.
adminSettings.resetOpsConfirm: Put every policy back to Default?
adminSettings.paidTicketsHint: Paid event tickets of an account that is deleted (by the member or by staff).
adminSettings.legacyTitle: Earlier online-payment settings (not used for new applications)
adminSettings.legacyLead: Membership applications no longer take a payment. These settings only affect orders and payments made with the earlier online payment system; leave them on Default unless you still have such records.

adminMembers.list_accountDeleted: The account was deleted. Personal data was removed; financial records are kept under an anonymous id.
adminMembers.list_notFound: That account no longer exists or was deleted.
adminMembers.f_provinceHint: Choose the country first (United States and Canada only). Leave blank if unknown.
adminMembers.f_directory: Listed in the member directory (active members only)
adminMembers.f_marketing: Receives ADAIG news and event updates by email
adminMembers.err_emailTaken: Another account already uses this email address.
adminMembers.err_org: The organization is too long (150 characters max).
adminMembers.err_job: The job title is too long (100 characters max).
adminMembers.err_country: Choose a country from the list.
adminMembers.err_province: This state or province doesn’t belong to the chosen country.
adminMembers.err_invalid: That change isn’t valid. Nothing was saved.
adminMembers.err_notAdmin: Your admin session has ended. Sign in again.
adminMembers.err_pw_short: The password must be at least 12 characters.
adminMembers.err_pw_long: The password must be 128 characters or fewer.
adminMembers.err_pw_blank: The password can’t be only spaces.
adminMembers.err_pw_common: This password is too common or matches the email. Choose another one, or leave the field blank to generate one.
adminMembers.err_confirmDelete: Tick the confirmation box to delete the account.
adminMembers.err_stale: This membership changed in the meantime (another staff member or the member). Nothing was changed; check the current status.
adminMembers.err_openExists: This person already has an open membership (active, under review or unpaid). Close it first: one open membership per person.
adminMembers.err_deleted: This account was deleted; its records are read-only.
adminMembers.err_date: Choose a date after today and at most 10 years ahead.
adminMembers.err_cpe: Enter a title, hours between 0.25 and 100, and a status.
adminMembers.err_alreadyDecided: This application was already decided by another staff member. Nothing was changed.
adminMembers.msg_membershipAdded: Membership added. It is active now.
adminMembers.msg_approved: Application approved. The membership is now active for one year, and the member is emailed a welcome message.
adminMembers.msg_rejected: Application rejected. The applicant is emailed the decision and the reason, which also appears under My membership.
adminMembers.deletedBody: Deleted on {date}. Personal data was removed; memberships, paid registrations and the audit log are kept for financial records.
adminMembers.profileNewHint: Who the account is for. Name and email are required; the person can update the rest later in Profile & privacy.
adminMembers.roleHint: Guest or member follows the memberships: approving or adding a membership makes a guest a member; when the last active membership ends, a member becomes a guest again. Admin Portal access is managed in Users.
adminMembers.pwHint: Sets a new password and shows it once, here only. Give it to the person through a safe channel and ask them to change it in Profile & privacy. The person is signed out everywhere they were signed in and receives an email saying their password was reset (the email never contains the password).
adminMembers.pwFieldHint: Leave blank to generate a strong one. At least 12 characters.
adminMembers.pwOnce: Copy it now; it won’t be shown again:
adminMembers.membershipsHint: Newest first. One open membership (active or under review) per person.
adminMembers.paid: Payment received through the former online checkout (no longer used)
adminMembers.lapseConfirm: The membership ends now (not renewed). The member loses member access; nothing is refunded.
adminMembers.cancelConfirm: The membership is canceled now. Nothing is refunded or flagged for refund.
adminMembers.grantHint: Creates an active membership (for example someone who joined offline). Nothing is charged online.
adminMembers.cpeRemoveConfirm: Remove this CPE entry? The member’s CPE total changes immediately.
adminMembers.deleteBody: Same as “Delete my account” in Profile & privacy: removes the name, email, password, organization, job title, preferences, CPE log, free or unpaid registrations and contact messages, and cancels open memberships without refund. Memberships, paid registrations and the audit log are kept for financial records under an anonymous id. This can’t be undone.
adminMembers.deleteConfirm: I understand that {name}’s account and personal data are deleted permanently
adminMembers.newHint: For a member or guest who joined offline. The person signs in with this email and the password below. Admin Portal users are created in Users.
adminMembers.err_roleNeedsMembership: Add a membership to make this person a member (Memberships below, or a tier when you create the account).
adminMembers.err_roleHasMembership: This person has an active membership, so they stay a member. End the membership first.

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.lead: People who can sign in to the Admin Portal. Association members and guests are managed in Members.
adminUsers.newLead: The account can sign in right away with this password. Share it through a safe channel: no invitation or email is sent.
adminUsers.pwHint: At least 12 characters. Not a common password and not the email address.
adminUsers.roleHint: The role decides which Admin Portal tools this user can see and use.
adminUsers.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They are signed out right away and can’t sign in until reactivated.
adminUsers.pwResetHint: Set a new password for this user. They are signed out everywhere and must use the new password. It is never shown again. Active users receive an email saying their password was reset (without the password).
adminUsers.selfNote: This is your account. You can change your name here and your password in Profile & privacy. Another admin can change your email, role or status.
adminUsers.superNote: Only a Super Admin can change a Super Admin.
adminUsers.targetNote: This user’s role has permissions you don’t have, so you can’t change it.
adminUsers.membershipNote: This account also has a membership record ({tier}, {status}). It is kept unchanged.
adminUsers.msg_created: User created. They can sign in now.
adminUsers.msg_roleChanged: Role changed. The user was signed out and gets the new access when they sign in again.
adminUsers.msg_activated: User reactivated. They can sign in again.
adminUsers.msg_pwReset: New password set. The user was signed out everywhere.
adminUsers.err_emailTaken: This email address is already used by another account (member, guest or admin). Use a different one.
adminUsers.err_pw_short: The password must be at least 12 characters.
adminUsers.err_pw_long: The password must be 128 characters or fewer.
adminUsers.err_pw_blank: The password can’t be only spaces.
adminUsers.err_pw_common: This password is too common or matches the email. Choose another one.
adminUsers.err_role: Choose a role from the list.
adminUsers.err_roleNotAllowed: You can’t assign a role with permissions your own role doesn’t have.
adminUsers.err_superOnly: Only a Super Admin can assign the Super Admin role or change a Super Admin.
adminUsers.err_target: You can’t change this user: their role has permissions you don’t have.
adminUsers.err_peer: You can’t change this user: their role has the same permissions as yours. Ask a Super Admin or an admin with more permissions.
adminUsers.err_emailSelf: You can’t change your own sign-in email. Ask another admin with access to Users to change it.
adminUsers.err_conflict: This user was changed by someone else in the meantime. Check the page and try again.
adminUsers.err_self: You can’t change your own role or status, or reset your own password here. Use Profile & privacy, or ask another admin.
adminUsers.err_lastSuperAdmin: This is the last active Super Admin. Give another active user the Super Admin role first.
adminUsers.err_session: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
adminUsers.emptyInactiveHint: Deactivated accounts are listed here. They keep their history and can be reactivated at any time.
adminUsers.showingFirst: Showing the first {n} of {total}. Search to narrow the list.
adminUsers.newDetailsHint: The name shown in the Admin Portal and the email address used to sign in.
adminUsers.emailHint: Used to sign in. It can’t already belong to another account (member, guest or admin).
adminUsers.pwSectionHint: The first password for this account. It is stored securely and can’t be viewed again.
adminUsers.roleSelectHint: Only roles whose permissions you also have are listed.
adminUsers.emailHintSelf: The address you sign in with. You can’t change it yourself: another admin who is allowed to manage your account can.
adminUsers.emailHintOther: The address this user signs in with. If you change it, a security notice is sent to the previous address.
adminUsers.inactiveBanner: This account is deactivated. The user can’t sign in until it is reactivated.
adminUsers.roleChangeHint: Changing the role signs the user out. They get the new access when they sign in again.
adminUsers.lastSuperNote: This is the last active Super Admin, so their role and status can’t be changed.
adminUsers.selfRoleNote: You can’t change your own role. Another admin with access to Users can.
adminUsers.selfStatusNote: You can’t deactivate your own account.
adminUsers.selfPwNote: You can’t reset your own password here. Change it in Profile & privacy.
adminUsers.viewRole: See what the {role} role can do
adminUsers.statusHint: Deactivated users can’t sign in. Their history is kept and they can be reactivated at any time.
adminUsers.deactivateCheck: I understand they will be signed out right away.
adminUsers.peerNote: This user has the same permissions as you, so you can’t change their account. A Super Admin or an admin with more permissions can.

adminRoles.title: Roles
adminRoles.lead: Roles decide what Admin Portal users can see and do. Changes apply from each user’s next page load.
adminRoles.usersN: {n, plural, =0 {No users} one {# user} other {# users}}
adminRoles.modHint_system: Overview, Settings, Audit log, System status
adminRoles.notYours: Your role doesn’t have this permission
adminRoles.permsHint: Create, Edit and Delete include View. You can only grant permissions your own role has.
adminRoles.emptyWarn: No permissions selected: users with this role can sign in but see no admin tools.
adminRoles.permsHintRO: Create, Edit and Delete include View.
adminRoles.noPerms: This role has no permissions: its users can sign in but see no admin tools.
adminRoles.superNote: Super Admin is the system role with every permission. Its name and permissions can’t be changed and it can’t be deleted.
adminRoles.ownRoleNote: This is your own role. Another admin can change it.
adminRoles.targetNote: This role has permissions you don’t have, so you can’t change it.
adminRoles.deleteBody: Deleting a role can’t be undone.
adminRoles.deleteInUse: {n, plural, one {# user has} other {# users have}} this role. Give them another role first.
adminRoles.deleteConfirm: I understand this role will be deleted.
adminRoles.msg_saved: Role saved. Users with this role get the new permissions on their next page load.
adminRoles.err_nameTaken: Another role already has this name.
adminRoles.err_nameSimilar: This name looks too much like the existing role “{name}”. Choose a clearly different name.
adminRoles.err_nameChars: Use visible letters from one alphabet, numbers and simple punctuation. Hidden characters and mixed alphabets (for example Latin with Cyrillic or Greek) aren’t allowed.
adminRoles.err_description: The description is too long (300 characters max).
adminRoles.err_escalation: You can’t grant permissions your own role doesn’t have.
adminRoles.err_systemRole: The Super Admin role can’t be changed or deleted.
adminRoles.err_ownRole: You can’t change or delete your own role.
adminRoles.emptyBody: Create a role to decide which Admin Portal tools a group of users can see and use.
adminRoles.detailsHint: A short name people will recognise, and what the role is for.
adminRoles.notYoursLegend: Greyed-out boxes are permissions your own role doesn’t have, so you can’t grant them.
adminRoles.err_target: You can’t change a role that has permissions you don’t have.
adminRoles.err_inUse: This role is assigned to users. Give them another role first.
adminRoles.err_conflict: Someone else changed this role in the meantime. Check it and save again.
adminRoles.err_session: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
